weather.temperature_boundary: preceding-hour mean Celsius, UTC half-open intervals
weather.quality: Primary checks; no climate homogenization; reserved Q fields are not quality-pass claims

source_evidence.temperature: OBS preceding-hour mean at Budapest44527; original quality flags do not establish homogenized climate data
source_evidence.load: DER / E2_PROVISIONAL_BASE; accepted native Actual Total Load
source_evidence.generation: Source record Q with QUALIFIED_E2_MODEL_USE; published actual may include provider estimates

spatial_boundary: Budapest station44527 weather paired with HU bidding-zone source load/generation; no national meteorological representativeness or causal temperature response
validation_debt: Station-only weather and original quality/annual support; no national spatial weighting or return-period inference
excluded_claims: Unmet demand, future adequacy, LOLE or capacity headroom
Programme heat/electricity, national weather or participant scaling
A complete meteorological winter or Budapest civil-year generation panel
A joint probability distribution, causal response, risk forecast or design return period
Prices, costs, household/fiscal economics or national feasibility
Public redistribution of originals or complete numeric panels
Combining independently selected extrema into one historical event
Hourly/window averages as quarter-hour or instantaneous peaks
selection_interpretation: Single-metric-selected co-occurring historical windows; not a demonstration that all stressors were jointly extreme
window_start_grid: UTC whole-hour starts, fixed physical duration, no wrap, padding or incomplete windows
